# Commit message rules

- Use Conventional Commits
- Format: type(scope): summary
- Types allowed: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore
- Keep first line under 100 chars
- Use imperative mood
- Do not mention AI assistance
- Mention affected subsystem when relevant

Examples:
- feat(mapping): add project mapping import validation
- fix(media): clear resumable cache on project deletion
